query:
SELECT eo.id
        FROM email_outbox eo
        INNER JOIN turnover t
          ON eo.payload->>'turnover_url' LIKE ('%/admin/turnovers/' || t.id::text)
        WHERE t.booking_id = $1
          AND t.source_kind = 'booking'
          AND eo.template_id = $2
          AND eo.status = 'pending'::email_status
